ambient_events: The landing has been swept. Really swept, the silt pushed back to the walls in long strokes.
Three short chalk strokes on the brick at shoulder height, chalked over an older three.
Somewhere west, a whistle: two notes, falling. A few seconds later, from the north, two notes answer.
description: A dry brick landing at the foot of a drain riser: the storm shaft that climbs, up and up, into the back room of a certain repair shop on the surface. The Watch keep this stretch clean and quiet: it's the members' way down, out of the machine's sight the whole descent. The threshold itself lies east.
name: Terminus Landing
